validateMulticall(address,bytes,bool).notice: Validate a GMX multicall payload with full permission checks. Decodes the multicall bytes[], validates each inner call, and checks assets/receivers/markets using IGuardChecks callbacks via address(this). This consolidates all GMX validation into the library, reducing the calling contract's bytecode (EIP-170).
